item.title: India News Today – Tuesday, October 13, 2026
item.description: Opposition leaders have taken their fight over India's voter rolls to the Supreme Court. Lok Sabha Leader of Opposition Rahul Gandhi, Rajya Sabha Leader of Opposition Mallikarjun Kharge and other INDIA bloc leaders filed a joint petition challenging the Election Commission's Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls.
